    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TakeOrder_SubmitTicket" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholRequestYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholRequestDecision" targetRef="Task_GiveSommelierOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">orderIncludesAlcoholicBeverage = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSommelierOrder" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholRequestDecision" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholRequestMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiveOrder_RequestMerge" sourceRef="Task_GiveSommelierOrder" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholRequestMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestMerge_Assign" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholRequestMerge" targetRef="Task_AssignWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assign_PreparationSplit" sourceRef="Task_AssignWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationSplit_Kitchen" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Kitchen_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationSplit_SommelierDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholPrepDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholPrepYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholPrepDecision" targetRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicDrinks">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">orderIncludesAlcoholicBeverage = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAlcoholPrep" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholPrepDecision" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholPrepMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholTask_AlcoholPrepMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholPrepMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholPrepMerge_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholPrepMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationSplit_WaiterPrepSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPrepSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterPrepSplit_Cart" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPrepSplit" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterPrepSplit_Nonalcoholic" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPrepSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cart_WaiterPrepJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Nonalcoholic_WaiterPrepJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterPrepJoin_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPrepJoin" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationJoin_Deliver" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deliver_Return" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_OtherOrder" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_OtherOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeferBilling" name="Another order" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrder" targetRef="Task_WaitToBill">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">anotherOrderToPrepareOrDeliver = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillNow" name="No other order" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrder" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_BillingMerge" sourceRef="Task_WaitToBill" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingMerge_Debit" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Task_DebitAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Debit_End" sourceRef="Task_DebitAccount" targetRef="Event_OrderComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_EvanstonianRoomService"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/evanstonian-room-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RoomServiceOrder" name="Room-service order"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_RoomService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Hotel" name="The Evanstonian" processRef="Process_RoomService"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GuestOrder"
                      name="Room-service order"
                      sourceRef="Task_GuestCallsRoomService"
                      targetRef="Event_OrderCall"
                      messageRef="Message_RoomServiceOrder"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Call room service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_GuestStartsCall" name="Guest decides to call room service"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_GuestCallsRoomService"
                   name="Guest calls room service with the order"
                   messageRef="Message_RoomServiceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_GuestCallComplete" name="Room-service call made"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GuestStart_Call"
                       sourceRef="Event_GuestStartsCall"
                       targetRef="Task_GuestCallsRoomService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GuestCall_End"
                       sourceRef="Task_GuestCallsRoomService"
                       targetRef="Event_GuestCallComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoomService" name="Handle room-service order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_RoomService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Room-service manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_OrderCall</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitKitchenTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AfterTicketSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderSommelier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SommelierWaiterSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Kitchen" name="Kitchen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFood</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadyCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SommelierWaiterJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PreparationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnToStation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OtherOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitToBill</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_OrderComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_OrderCall" name="Guest calls room service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OrderCall" messageRef="Message_RoomServiceOrder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Room-service manager takes down the order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" name="Room-service manager submits the order ticket to the kitchen"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AfterTicketSplit" name="Kitchen preparation and manager follow-up"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Kitchen prepares the food"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSommelier" name="Room-service manager orders the sommelier to fetch wine and prepare other alcoholic beverages"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SommelierWaiterSplit" name="Sommelier preparation and waiter assignment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholDecision"
                           name="Does the order include wine or another alcoholic beverage?"
                           default="Flow_NoAlcoholicBeverages">
      <bpmn:documentation>Eighty percent of room-service orders include wine or another alcoholic beverage.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages" name="Sommelier fetches wine from the cellar and prepares other alcoholic beverages"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" name="Alcoholic beverage preparation path complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignWaiter" name="Room-service manager assigns the order to the waiter"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit" name="Prepare cart and nonalcoholic drinks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadyCart" name="Waiter readies the cart by putting on a tablecloth and gathering silverware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" name="Waiter prepares nonalcoholic drinks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin" name="Cart and nonalcoholic drinks ready"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SommelierWaiterJoin" name="Sommelier and waiter preparations complete"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Food, beverages, and cart ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Waiter delivers the prepared order to the guest's room"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnToStation" name="Waiter returns to the room-service station"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OtherOrder" name="Does the waiter have another order to prepare or deliver?" default="Flow_BillNow"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitToBill" name="Waiter waits to do the billing"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingMerge" name="Proceed to billing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitAccount" name="Waiter debits the guest's account"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_OrderComplete" name="Guest's account debited"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Call_TakeOrder" sourceRef="Event_OrderCall" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TakeOrder_SubmitTicket" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitTicket_AfterTicketSplit" sourceRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" targetRef="Gateway_AfterTicketSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AfterTicketSplit_Kitchen" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterTicketSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Kitchen_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AfterTicketSplit_OrderSommelier" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterTicketSplit" targetRef="Task_OrderSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderSommelier_SommelierWaiterSplit" sourceRef="Task_OrderSommelier" targetRef="Gateway_SommelierWaiterSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SommelierWaiterSplit_AlcoholDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_SommelierWaiterSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholDecision_Prepare" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholDecision" targetRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">orderIncludesAlcoholicBeverage</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAlcoholicBeverages" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholDecision" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages_AlcoholMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholMerge_SommelierWaiterJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" targetRef="Gateway_SommelierWaiterJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SommelierWaiterSplit_AssignWaiter" sourceRef="Gateway_SommelierWaiterSplit" targetRef="Task_AssignWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignWaiter_WaiterPreparationSplit" sourceRef="Task_AssignWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterPreparationSplit_Cart" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterPreparationSplit_NonalcoholicDrinks" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cart_WaiterPreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NonalcoholicDrinks_WaiterPreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterPreparationJoin_SommelierWaiterJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_SommelierWaiterJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SommelierWaiterJoin_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_SommelierWaiterJoin" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationJoin_Deliver" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deliver_Return" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_OtherOrder" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_OtherOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeferBilling" name="Another order" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrder" targetRef="Task_WaitToBill">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">anotherOrderToPrepareOrDeliver</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillNow" name="No other order" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrder" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_BillingMerge" sourceRef="Task_WaitToBill" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingMerge_Debit" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Task_DebitAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Debit_End" sourceRef="Task_DebitAccount" targetRef="Event_OrderComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: Use a parallel join when a shared continuation waits for all active parallel branches. Never use it to join mutually exclusive alternatives.
rules.situation: the description states that several required activities can proceed independently and that a later activity begins only after their results are ready.

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes an event or activity by its action, actor, object, recipient, or another meaningful qualifier: Label each BPMN element so that it preserves those stated details without substituting a broader or different meaning.
rules.situation: the description explicitly identifies the role responsible for an activity

rules.instruction: When the description states that several activities are all required before a later activity or outcome: Model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize all branches with a parallel gateway before the later activity or outcome.
rules.situation: the description states that one activity is performed while other required activities are underway, and that a later activity waits until all are complete

rules.instruction: When the description says that a participant performs an action that initiates the process: Model the process trigger with a start event, then model the participant’s described action as a distinct task; do not use the action itself as the start event.
rules.situation: the description states that a participant performs an action that initiates the process before the first internal activity
